payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the self-attention functions in the last layer of BERT are particularly relevant for aligning with human attention, as they show stronger correlations with human eye fixations compared to earlier layers.

claims.text: Self-attention functions in the last layer of BERT are more aligned with human attention, as they correlate better with human eye fixations during reading tasks.
Fine-tuning BERT does not significantly change the correlations of attention functions, suggesting that the last layer's attention is stable and relevant for analysis.
BERT's attention flow in the last layer has been shown to have superior alignment with human-generated explanations compared to other models.
